items.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - AI Agents
items.summary: Embed with customer teams, map their operations, and ship production AI agents.
items.requirements: Strong Python or TypeScript; LLM/tool-use experience; comfort in customer workshops; cloud deployment experience.

items.title: Full-Stack Engineer
items.summary: Build customer web apps, e-commerce front ends, and internal tools.
items.requirements: React/TypeScript or similar; REST design; SQL; Git and CI/CD.

items.title: Oracle Fusion ERP Consultant
items.summary: Lead Financials, Procurement or Projects implementations and AI-enabled extensions.
items.requirements: 5+ years Fusion ERP; at least two full-cycle implementations; FBDI/HDL/OIC familiarity.

items.title: Cloud & DevOps Engineer (Managed IT)
items.summary: Operate customer infrastructure on OCI and AWS as their outsourced IT team.
items.requirements: Terraform; Linux; networking and IAM; monitoring; OCI or AWS certification a plus.
